tools.name: sjothr_campaigns
tools.description: Public fundraising campaigns on Sjothr: company token, state, funding goal and capital raised in USDC, deadline and public record page.

tools.name: sjothr_campaign
tools.description: Public record of one Sjothr campaign by campaign id: token, vault, funding goal, capital raised, deadline, state and dossier reference.

tools.name: sjothr_rules
tools.description: Rules of a Sjothr raise: who pays which fee, how capital is released in stages by token-holder votes, when backers are refunded, and the risks.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Sjothr campaigns and guides (tokenize a company, raise money for a startup, tokenized equity, milestone-based funding); returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full record of one Sjothr campaign or full text of one guide, by id (from search).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
